title: Do Not Let Models Invent Numbers - Vinoo Ganesh, Kepler
talk_summary: Kepler's CEO describes an architecture where LLMs plan and cite but never write numbers: retrieval finds sources, deterministic code does arithmetic, and a post-processing filter strips any number that can't be traced to a registered citation. They report that native RAG+LLM setups refused ~11k citations in evals, ~3.8k of which were outright wrong numbers.

takeaways.what_they_do: Every fact/number must resolve to a registered source ID in a deterministic registry; if the post-processing filter can't match it, the number is removed from output rather than shown.
takeaways.evidence_quote: when we don't have a match, we strip that number
takeaways.numbers: refused 10,981 citations from evals; ~3,810 were straight-up wrong numbers

takeaways.technique: Push arithmetic to deterministic code, not the model
takeaways.what_they_do: Models plan and select tools; all computation (growth rates, margins, tables) is done by human-written deterministic code the model invokes, never by the model itself.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Code does the math, and code meaning the model is not writing the math
takeaways.numbers: a third of all citations are the math the model did not do

takeaways.technique: Search wide, then re-rank with cross-encoder + source trust
takeaways.what_they_do: Hybrid ANN+BM25 retrieval pulls ~60 docs, reciprocal-rank fusion, then a cross-encoder re-ranks with per-source trust weighting; conflicting sources are surfaced, not silently merged.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we search wide then we re-rank

takeaways.technique: Measure citation refusal rate as a quality metric
takeaways.what_they_do: They instrument the filter and report how many citations were refused and how many were wrong, treating that as the core quality number rather than trusting RAG output.

takeaways.technique: Model plans, deterministic layer executes and enforces invariants
takeaways.what_they_do: LLM produces a plan with full knowledge of available tools; deterministic software executes retrieval/compute and enforces the citation invariant so the platform is structurally incapable of emitting uncited facts.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the language models themselves are planning. Deterministic software handles every number or even more generally every single fact

takeaways.technique: Re-authorize every retrieval hit at document level
takeaways.what_they_do: Each retrieval hit is re-checked in Postgres against citation/value/document and tenant scope; scoped tokens issued only by auth, so cross-tenant leakage is blocked at query time.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every hit is reauthorized in Postgres, meaning we check the citation, the value, the document
